title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: new health signals in the Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the summary promises that no action is needed to enable the signals, although their default state is not documented. The licensing uncertainty is also misleading: Microsoft documents Pro Management incident generation and Pro-only ITSM integration, so administrators should not treat Basic entitlement as an unanswered question.

claims.quote: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the new Android signals are enabled on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android Calendar sync Storage health Secondary display health signals enabled default license price meter. Read Health signals and Signal settings: enable, disable and reset are described, but no arrival default is stated.

claims.claim: Nothing is required to turn the new signals on.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android Calendar sync Storage health Secondary display health signals enabled default license price meter. Read Health signals and Signal settings; neither says no enabling action is needed. The body instead says the default is unknown.
claims.fix: Replace 'nothing is required to turn them on' with 'Microsoft has not stated whether they are enabled on arrival'. Keep defaultState as unknown.

claims.fix: The path correctly reaches the settings page but stops before the deciding control. Replace it with 'Settings > Signals > signal > Disable' and state in the note that the same page also offers Enable and Reset to default.

claims.claim: Rooms with a stale calendar, a full disk or a mismatched second display fail in front of meeting participants.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android health signals network Teams meeting app Calendar sync automatic remediation incident notifications. Read Android Health signals descriptions: calendar and storage can affect meetings; display mismatch is described, but inevitable room failure is not.
claims.fix: Replace the opening sentence with 'Calendar sync failures can leave scheduled meetings missing or out of date, and critically low storage can affect device stability or meeting reliability.' These are the Android descriptions at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/signals.
